title: Class 32 · Apache and Dispatcher request processing
goal: Locate the first layer that changes or answers one public HTTP request after content is verified on Publish.
outputs: Spanish HTML and Markdown study guide

slides.title: Apache and Dispatcher request processing
key_points: Class 32 · Week 7 · September 29, 2026
Juan Maldonado
Follow a public URL to the response owner.

slides.title: Trace one HTTP request
key_points: Browser, CDN, Apache vhost, Dispatcher farm and filter, Publish.
Track Host and URL as each layer processes the request.
Compare status, Location and resolved path.

slides.title: The Apache virtual host
key_points: Host selects a vhost via ServerName or ServerAlias.
Check the enabled vhost and included rewrite rules.

slides.title: The Dispatcher farm
key_points: Farm matching uses the request host and URI.
The farm supplies virtualhosts, filter and renderer.

slides.title: Rewrite or redirect
key_points: An internal Apache rewrite keeps the browser URL.
An external redirect returns 301 or 302 with Location.

slides.title: Dispatcher request filters
key_points: A filter can match method, URL, selectors or extension.
Allowed requests continue to Publish; a denied filter request returns 404.
Use logs to prove the matched rule.

slides.title: Headers across the boundary
key_points: Host affects vhost and farm selection.
Check which request headers reach Publish through clientheaders.
Record response status, Location and cache headers.

slides.title: Who returned 403 or 404?
key_points: Check Apache access logs, Dispatcher decisions and Publish request logs.
HTTP status alone does not name the layer.

slides.title: Run Dispatcher locally
key_points: Browser at localhost:8080, Dispatcher Tools Docker and Publish at localhost:4503.
Use the project host and path in curl.

slides.title: Three responses, three checks
key_points: 301/302 from Apache: inspect redirect rule.
404 at Dispatcher: inspect farm and filter logs.
404 at Publish: inspect resolved content path.

slides.title: Find the first divergence
key_points: Capture Host and URL; inspect status and Location.
Read Apache and Dispatcher logs; compare the same path on Publish.

slides.title: Questions
key_points: Thank you.
